skill.name: video-ad-specs
skill.description: Create platform-specific video ad plans and production prompts for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
skill.summary: Plan video ads with platform specs, AIDA structure, captions, and production prompts.
skill.author: halt-catch-fire

security_audit.summary: The skill is a Markdown guide for video ad planning and production with platform-specific specifications. Several static shell findings are real because the guide instructs users to run belt and npx commands that contact external services or install other skills; no prompt injection text was found.

remediation.issue: External belt commands send prompts or media to third-party generation services.
remediation.suggestion: State that users should review prompts, files, and account permissions before running belt app run commands.

remediation.issue: The guide recommends installing additional skills with npx skills add.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit user confirmation before installation and point users to trusted package sources.

remediation.issue: The required CLI install instructions use a raw GitHub URL.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer stable, versioned, and signed installation documentation when available.

content.value_statement: Video ad teams must match each platform format, length, caption, and safe-zone rule. This skill organizes those requirements and turns them into practical creative prompts.
actual_capabilities: Lists aspect ratios, resolutions, duration ranges, and caption rules for major ad platforms.
Maps TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn formats to practical production choices.
Provides AIDA timing guidance for hooks, interest, desire, and calls to action.
Includes example production prompts for vertical, square, and bumper video ads.
Adds caption guidance for silent autoplay and mobile readability.
Supplies a final checklist for platform-specific video ad review.
limitations: Platform policies and ad specifications may change after the guide is published.
The skill does not verify campaign compliance with legal, brand, or industry rules.
Video generation examples require the separate belt CLI and external services.
It provides creative structure, not media buying strategy or performance forecasts.

use_cases.title: Launch a TikTok Ad Concept
use_cases.description: Create a vertical ad plan with a fast hook, captions, and a clear final call to action.

use_cases.title: Adapt One Offer Across Platforms
use_cases.description: Convert one campaign idea into different specs for Reels, Stories, Shorts, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Prompts
use_cases.description: Draft video, voiceover, merge, and caption prompts that match the required ad format.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Social Video Ad
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one platform-ready ad outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second TikTok video ad plan for [product]. Include aspect ratio, hook, scenes, captions, and CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Platform Versions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for multi-platform creative adaptation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this offer for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn. Show format, duration, tone, and caption changes.

prompt_templates.title: Build an AIDA Storyboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for structured creative planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an AIDA storyboard for a 30-second video ad about [offer]. Include timing, visuals, voiceover, captions, and CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Production-Ready Prompts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for external video generation workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write production prompts for a vertical ad using video generation, voiceover, audio merge, and caption steps. Include safe-zone and mute-viewing notes.

output_examples.input: Create a 6-second YouTube bumper for a reporting automation tool.
output_examples.output: A one-message bumper plan with a 16:9 format, fast product montage, final logo reveal, and a short trial CTA.

output_examples.input: Turn a desktop software offer into a LinkedIn feed video ad.
output_examples.output: A square or widescreen professional ad outline with silent-autoplay captions, office context, problem framing, product demo, and concise CTA.

output_examples.input: Prepare an Instagram Stories ad for a consumer accessory.
output_examples.output: A vertical 9:16 sequence with unsafe-zone reminders, a first-frame hook, readable captions, product reveal, and link-focused action step.

best_practices: Choose the target platform before writing the script or generation prompt.
Place the hook in the first three seconds and keep captions readable on mobile.
Create separate versions for different aspect ratios, tones, and duration limits.
anti_patterns: Using one landscape video for every social platform.
Skipping captions because the ad includes voiceover.
Putting key text inside platform UI safe zones.

faq.question: Does this skill create finished video files?
faq.answer: It provides specifications, structures, and example prompts. Finished files require external video tools such as the belt CLI examples.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, YouTube, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn video ads.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include caption guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains caption placement, readability, contrast, and silent-autoplay needs.

faq.question: Are the platform specs guaranteed current?
faq.answer: No. Platform requirements can change, so verify final ads against each platform before launch.

faq.question: Does it replace legal or brand review?
faq.answer: No. Review regulated claims, brand rules, and platform policies before publishing any ad.
